name: Laravel 12 / Livewire / Alpine / Tailwind
description: Classic web stack (TALL): Laravel 12 backend with Livewire 3 full-page components + Alpine 3 + Tailwind CSS 3 (four-screen journey, session-cookie auth, fixed bounded algorithm workbench, /api/v1 JSON envelope with X-Request-Id correlation, failed-login throttle with 429 + Retry-After) implemented and tested (PHPUnit feature suite incl. Livewire::test component tests + real-HTTP smoke script). No SPA framework, no app-authored client JS.
